environment.precision: FP32 SO(2), TF32 and AMP disabled

protocol.cache: new process and empty Inductor/Triton caches per run; driver/system caches not purged
protocol.timing: full ASE energy/force/virial/stress API including neighbor building and host gaps
protocol.primary_memory: complete high-water mark from model loading through first JIT, warmup and 30 measured calls
protocol.steady_memory: separate 30-call replay after resetting peak counters; reserved cache not emptied

monitor.scope: 250 ms samples over each whole process, including compilation and idle; no foreign compute process detected

torch_reference.caveat: accuracy reference only; GPU1 timing not mixed into GPU0 performance table

test_summary.training_and_higher_order: dispatch guard tests, not full training validation
test_summary.local_input_alpha_gradients: 24 edge-count/distribution cases, bitwise equal, finite, caller tensors unchanged

limitations: Latest cold-process matrix covers Neo N64 only; no multi-model/PT2 acceptance claim.
Small-path residual reuse overlaps the earlier internal inplace optimization; percentages are not additive.
Earlier opaque two-cohort N64 path regressed 6.85-7.81%; it is not the reported small path.

Cold-process percentage differences alone are not significance tests; the fixed-3%-noise interpretation is retired by the controlled timing follow-up. Full model outputs are tolerance-equivalent, not bitwise guaranteed.
